sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using Ebneely's services, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.title: 2. Services Description
sections.content: Ebneely provides construction and building services including but not limited to residential construction, commercial projects, renovation, interior design, project management, and consultation services. All services are subject to separate contractual agreements.

sections.title: 3. User Responsibilities
content: Provide accurate and complete information when requested
Maintain the confidentiality of any account credentials
Use our services in compliance with applicable laws
Not engage in any activity that disrupts our services
Provide timely feedback and approvals for project milestones

sections.title: 4. Payment Terms
sections.content: Payment terms and schedules will be outlined in individual project contracts. A deposit may be required before commencement of work. All prices are subject to change and will be communicated in advance.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content, designs, and materials created by Ebneely remain our intellectual property until full payment is received. Upon completion and full payment, ownership rights will be transferred as specified in the project contract.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Ebneely shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of our services. Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the specific service in question.

sections.title: 7. Privacy
sections.content: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.

sections.title: 8. Modifications
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of modified terms.

sections.title: 9. Governing Law
sections.content: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Riyadh.

sections.title: 10. Contact Information
sections.content: For questions about these Terms & Conditions, please contact us through our official channels.
